    • values

    • valueOf

      public static EditorParameterizedCommand valueOf(String name)
      Returns the enum constant of this class with the specified name. The string must match exactly an identifier used to declare an enum constant in this class. (Extraneous whitespace characters are not permitted.)
      Parameters:
      name - the name of the enum constant to be returned.
      Returns:
      the enum constant with the specified name
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if this enum class has no constant with the specified name
      NullPointerException - if the argument is null

    • id

      public String id()
      Returns:
      the host command identifier: the constant name lowercased and dot-separated, computed with Locale.ROOT so it does not shift with the default locale

    • availability

      public EditorParameterizedCommand.Availability availability()
      Returns:
      EditorParameterizedCommand.Availability.TYPED_CONTRACT_VERIFIED for the handful of commands that already have a verified request record behind them, and EditorParameterizedCommand.Availability.EVIDENCE_REQUIRED for every other constant — those are inventoried but not yet callable with a typed request

    • supports

      public boolean supports(String cubismVersion)
      Parameters:
      cubismVersion - an exact Editor version string such as "5.2.03"; compared for equality, never parsed as a range
      Returns:
      whether this command was observed on that version; a few constants are version-exclusive (for example FADE_SETTING on 5.3.02 only)
